body: Hello, now I waited 5-6 months and i want to get unbanned! I won't hack plz unban me! They said i was going to wait 5 months and appeal after 6 months again and here I am! Unban me plz! My Minecraft ign is AlwaysRod! I was banned for ban evasion!

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
Hey melle

Your current ban is for ban evading which was only given out 2 months ago, we are very strict on ban evading.Therefore you will have  to at least wait 5-8 months from the the current punishment of ban evading till you can be possibly appealed. The 5-6 you are basing of is since the hacking punishment. 



For now this appeal is denied.
I will lock in roughly 24 hours since this response

-Pizza
